DiscountRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Discount used in calculating and applying the discount on the sales transaction paid.

PercentBased.description: Product: ALL Description: True if the discount is a percentage; null or false if discount based on amount.

DiscountPercent.description: Product: ALL Description: Percentage by which the amount due is reduced, from 0% to 100%. To enter a discount of 8.5% use 8.5, not 0.085.

DiscountAccountRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Income account used to track discounts received from vendors on purchases.
